title: Preserve unauthenticated downloads and report test limits

context.hint: Check redirect credential handling separately for each selected downloader.
context.surface: A shell tool selects a downloader to fetch artifacts from a configured authenticated mirror.
assumptions: Use synthetic credentials and two disposable local HTTP fixtures.

review.invariant: Credential-policy enforcement preserves ordinary unauthenticated download behavior.
review.verification: Repeat the local redirect control without a credential and verify body delivery. Run related downloader regressions and compare any environmental failure with baseline.

source_observation.summary: The unauthenticated local control succeeded after repair. Thirteen related tests passed. A file-permission assertion failed identically on baseline and repaired copies. Other downloader implementations used stubs rather than real end-to-end transport checks.
